\begin{equation}
\begin{split}
&
  \mathbb{P}\left(  
    \left[  
      \sum_{ n = 1 }^N \left(  X_n - \mathbb{E}[ X_n ]  \right) 
     \right] 
    \geq \varepsilon
   \right)
  =
  \mathbb{P}\left(  
    \left[  
      \sum_{ n = 1 }^N Y_n 
     \right] 
    \geq \varepsilon
   \right)
  \leq 
  \inf_{ \lambda \in [0,\infty) }
  \left( 
    e^{ - \lambda \varepsilon }
    \,
    \mathbb{M}_{ \sum_{ n = 1 }^N Y_n }( \lambda )
   \right)
\\ & =
  \inf_{ \lambda \in [0,\infty) }
  \left( 
    e^{ - \lambda \varepsilon }
    \left[ 
      \prod_{ n = 1 }^N
      \mathbb{M}_{ Y_n }( \lambda )
     \right]
   \right)
  =
  \inf_{ \lambda \in [0,\infty) }
  \left( 
    e^{ - \lambda \varepsilon }
    \left[ 
      \prod_{ n = 1 }^N
      \mathbb{M}_{ X_n - \mathbb{E}[ X_n ] }( \lambda )
     \right]
   \right)
  .
\end{split}
\end{equation}
